chat.welcomeMessage:
Sannu! 👋 Ni ne mataimakinka a harkar noma.

Zan iya taimaka maka da:
• Noma (irin su hatsi, kayan lambu, 'ya'yan itace, furanni)
• Kiwo (irin su dabbobi, kaji, kifi)
• Kariya daga kwari da cututtuka
• Shawara kan yanayi da kasuwa

Ta yaya zan iya taimaka maka yau?

agrivision.name: AgriVision
agrivision.tagline: Gano da tantance cututtukan shuka da AI
agrivision.description: Bincika hotunan shuka don gano cututtuka, kwari, da rashin sinadarai. Sami gano cuta nan take tare da shawarwarin magani da kariya.

isdaSoil.name: ISDA Soil
isdaSoil.tagline: Siffofin ƙasa da nazarin sinadarai masu gina jiki na Afirka
isdaSoil.description: Samo cikakken bayani game da ƙasa ciki har da pH, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, da sauran sinadarai. Yana rufe dukkan Afirka da daidaiton mita 30.

accuweather.name: AccuWeather
accuweather.tagline: Yanayin yanzu da hasashen yanayi a faɗin duniya
accuweather.description: Sami bayanan yanayi na ainihin lokaci ciki har da zafin jiki, zafi, saurin iska, da ruwan sama. Hasashe na kwana 15.

gapWeather.name: GAP Weather
gapWeather.tagline: Hasashen yanayi na noma na Kenya
gapWeather.description: Musamman hasashen yanayi na noma a Kenya. Ya haɗa da fitar ruwa, hasken rana, da ruwan sama don yanke shawara kan noma.

edacap.name: EDACaP Climate
edacap.tagline: Hasashen yanayi na kaka na Habasha
edacap.description: Hasashen yanayi na kaka ciki har da zafin jiki da ruwan sama. Yana taimaka wa manoma su tsara lokacin shuka da girbi.

weatherapi.name: WeatherAPI
weatherapi.tagline: Bayanan yanayi na wurare a faɗin duniya
weatherapi.description: Cikakken hidimar bayanan yanayi da ke ba da yanayin yanzu da hasashe na wurare a faɗin duniya.

tomorrowIo.name: Tomorrow.io
tomorrowIo.description: Cikakken tsarin hankali na yanayi da ke da hasashe mai kyau da iya hasashen nan take.

feedFormulation.name: Haɗin Ciyarwa
feedFormulation.tagline: Ƙididdigar abinci mai kyau na shanu masu nono
feedFormulation.description: Ƙididdige mafi arha abincin dabbobi ga shanu masu nono. Yana la'akari da burin samar da nono, nauyin jiki, da abincin dabbobi na gida.

nextgen.name: NextGen Taki
nextgen.tagline: Shawara kan taki na musamman ga wuri na Habasha
nextgen.description: Samo daidaitattun shawarwarin taki dangane da ainihin wurin da kake. Ya haɗa da na halitta (compost, vermicompost) da na sinadarai (Urea, NPS).

decisionTree.name: Itacen Yanke Shawara na Noma
decisionTree.description: Samo shawarwarin sarrafa noma dangane da matakin girma da yanayin yanzu. Yana taimaka maka yanke shawara kan maganin kwari, ban ruwa, da girbi.

gapAgriculture.name: GAP Noma
gapAgriculture.description: Janar hidimar shawarwari kan sarrafa noma da dabbobi.

plantix.name: Plantix
plantix.tagline: Gano ciwon shuka da tallafin harsuna 21
plantix.description: Gano ciwon shuka daga hotuna ta amfani da AI na Plantix.

googleWeather.name: Google Weather
googleWeather.tagline: Yanayi na duniya tare da hasashen gaba da tarihi
googleWeather.description: Cikakken bayanan yanayi daga Google da hasashen kwana 10, hasashen sa'a-sa'a na awanni 240, da tarihin yanayi na awanni 24 da suka gabata.
